about.title: About Shellist Law Firm
text: Whether your legal issue is civil or criminal, in the end, your success depends on trial skills. At The Shellist Law Firm, PLLC, every member of our team is a trial attorney to the core.

The ability to persuade an audience to see your side of the story—and not your opponent’s—is an art. It’s what brings you leverage in a legal battle. And it’s what makes success possible in criminal and civil matters alike. Whether you are seeking legal counsel over criminal allegations, corporate compliance, or civil causes of action, you will want an experienced trial attorney on your team.

At The Shellist Law Firm, we believe that every case is unique and requires its own creative and well-planned strategy. No two individuals or cases are alike. At our firm, we first like to meet with the clients to get to know them and their stories. Who they are, where they came from, and what they say happened: these are all important factors that need to be explored prior to mapping out a sound legal strategy.
